what: Pressing a magazine-cover-like card makes a clone appear in place (.25s) and scale up 1.5× (.3s power3.in). That year’s color panel appears at the clone’s spot at .2s and spreads to full screen by .5s. The cover image inside the panel drifts slowly left and right (3s each), then after 1s the page moves on to the link. On the arriving page, elements with look: arrive (title panel, left band) shrink the same full-screen panel down to their own size in 1s and peel it away over 3s. The cover becomes the screen, then folds into the next page’s header.

options.--fx-sheet: Panel color (set on that card via style), default var(--kf-accent) — if the color differs each year, it differs per card
options.zoom: Scale at which the copy grows, default 1.5
options.wait: Wait before the panel covers the screen and moves on (seconds), default 1
options.pan: Width over which the panel artwork flows (% of artwork width), default 12
options.wide: Panel image width (% of panel), default 120
options.look: arrive — where the panel folds in on the new page (masthead panel, etc.)
options.shrink: Shrinking length on the arrive side (sec), default 1
options.fade: Clearing length on the arrive side (seconds), default 3
options.[data-fx-part=art]: Graphic to flow onto the panel (optional), an SVG or image inside the cover

note: The original inserts the next page into the same document and shrinks the panel only to the width of the left strip (screen height) of that year’s index — the part swaps pages and shrinks to the box (width and height) of the arrive element. Attached to an element of screen height like the left strip, it gives the same shape. In the original phone view, the panel settles .5s below the header, then folds to height 0 in 1s
